## Accessibility checklist (wiki/client/design-rules.md)

- [ ] One task per screen; Back/Next and Help in the usual spots
- [ ] Picture first, short verb-first label, full sentence; read-aloud on demand only
- [ ] Progress shown; no timeouts, popups, or anything that moves on its own
- [ ] High-contrast dark theme, Lexend, touch targets ≥ 48dp (bigger on tablet)
- [ ] Works on tablet (two-pane) and phone (one-pane), portrait and landscape
- [ ] No participant names, photos or health details in code, fixtures or screenshots
